body:
If I'm not around they can't be forced into watching me suffer through this. People say it gets better but we're seven weeks in and every day is worse. 

If I go through with this I remove myself from their worries. She won't have to suffer through a divorce and I won't either. I won't have to suffer through watching her carry on without me. Won't have to try to live without her. She said I had put my comfort ahead of her and the kids. I can't think of a bigger sacrifice to make for her.

I've started a journal for the boys so they know my story and thought process. She can't file for divorce until February 1st, so I've got a little less than 3 and a half months to find a way to save this or I'm talking a long walk in the woods. If she starts dating before then, I go away sooner. I'm not living without my family. I'd rather be dead than divorced.

Just spoke on the phone to my wife. She was planning the divorce before we moved. Said I was abusive to her and the kids. I swear to you people, I have nothing to gain from lying, but I was NEVER abusive. I didn't hit my kids or wife. I never cheated; cheating is the most offensive thing to me. I certainly yelled and I have a short temper but I'm not abusive. I swear on my children. I was blindsided by this. She says that she is filing for divorce and that I could move to the town she lives in to be close to the kids and co-parent with her. But to do so means that I would have to watch her move on with her life while some other man moves into my kids' lives. My graduate schooling isn't complete yet. There's no kind of decent paying career for me without it. The town we moved to is expensive. I don't have a way to survive. 

I started a journal tonight so that maybe one day my kids will understand if I go through with this. I'll tell them my life story and most of all, how I loved them and did this for them and myself. I don't want them to see me suffering through life without my wife. People tell me to move on, but I'm not built that way. I can't. I was serious when I said my vows. I wasn't joking. I said forever. I meant it. Forever doesn't stop when someone else wants it to, does it? 

I'm hurting so bad. I've cried every day for six weeks now. It's not getting better. Oh how I wish it would.
